name: Hotel Fernblick Tirol
beschreibung: Hotel Fernblick Tirol is located in Fiss, elevated on the sunny high plateau of the Tyrolean Oberland. The property offers stunning panoramic mountain views and immediate access to the premier Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski and recreation area, alongside a vast network of summer hiking trails. Facilities include a revitalising wellness area with saunas, an inviting restaurant serving regional culinary treats, and peaceful accommodations ideal for active relaxation.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Fernblick Tirol in Fiss features panoramic alpine views, a soothing wellness area, fine dining, and direct access to the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski and hiking paradise.
